thread:
Ellen: Noticing a recurring confusion: merged p95 for /generate is spiking vs endpoint view after we enabled weighted routing. p50 steady. Anyone seen the same?
Marco: Yup. I dug a bit - raw-sample p95 ~= 210ms, merged p95 ~= 340ms. Total counts identical.
Tess: That screams rollup merge artifact. We merge per-route tdigests weighted by sample_count. Compression on route rollups is 120 which can lose tail detail.
Ellen: Is the provenance preserved through merge? If not, we can't tell which route contributes the tail.
Marco: Provenance tag exists but we strip tags during serialization to save bytes. Bad tradeoff here.
Tess: Two quick fixes: 1) fallback to raw-sample p95 when total_count < 5k or when merged p95 differs from raw by >20%. 2) add a provenance mini-badge in the tooltip listing top 2 contributing routes and their sample fractions.
Ellen: UX for product: show an inline warning next to merged percentiles: "Merged percentiles use per-route rollups; tails can differ from raw samples. Click to inspect."
Marco: Also propose a new merge_mode="sample-aware" which pulls raw-sample for tail quantiles and tdigests for median. That reduces bandwidth but keeps tail fidelity.
Tess: I'll prototype sample-aware merge. Plan: run A/B on canaries with merge_mode conservative vs sample-aware and measure p95 delta.
metrics-bot: Ack - I'll add a toggle to console for "view raw p95" and surface provenance badge. ETA 36h.
Ellen: Action items: Tess - prototype merge_mode sample-aware + backfill; Marco - stop stripping provenance on route rollups; metrics-bot - add tooltip badge and raw-p95 toggle; I'll draft the rollout note warning.
Ellen: Thanks. If anyone wants to pair on the prototype tomorrow, ping me.
